parcels.HANDLE: Zero-padded citywide parcel identifier used as the common join key across St. Louis parcel datasets; the portal's field notes describe it as 'a numbering schema originally introduced to aid in the handling of condominiums' and mark it DEPRECATED.
parcels.ParcelId: Unformatted parcel ID in the numbering schema introduced by the Assessor's office in 2021 (portal field definition).
parcels.LowerAsrParcelId: The Assessor's post-2021 parcel ID carried in lowercase/unformatted form (variant of AsrParcelId; not separately documented on the portal).
parcels.ColParcelId: Unformatted Collector of Revenue parcel ID — the pre-2021 parcel numbering scheme used across many city departments (portal field definition).
parcels.ColCityBlock: Collector of Revenue's city block number (portal field definition).
parcels.ColParcel: Collector of Revenue's parcel number, unique only within its parent city block (portal field definition).
parcels.CityBlock: City block number component of the parcel key (portal: 'key fields: CITYBLOCK, PARCEL, OWNERCODE'); a float-like identifier where the decimal part distinguishes block subdivisions.
parcels.Parcel: Parcel number within the city block, the second component of the CityBlock/Parcel/OwnerCode parcel key.
parcels.OwnerCode: Third component of the parcel key, a taxing-status code: 0 Standard, 1 Redevelopment Taxable Portion, 2 Redevelopment Exempt Portion, 3 In Lieu of Payment, 4 Charitable Exempt Portion, 5 Charitable Taxable Portion, 6 Mixed Use Residential Portion, 7 Mixed Use Commercial Portion, 8 Sign, 9 Demo/Maintenance Charge (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerCode table).
parcels.AsrClassCode: Assessor's owner-class code identifying the type of owner, e.g. 100 Individual, 200 Company, 49 Land Re-Utilization (LRA), 14 State of Missouri, 2 MSD, plus many church/institution codes (city controlled vocabulary 'Assessor Class Code').
parcels.PropertyClassCode: Statutory property classification: 10 Agricultural, 12 Commercial, 15 Residential, 17 Exempt, and combination codes 11/13/14/16 for mixed classifications (city controlled vocabulary 'Property Class Code').
parcels.AsrLandUse1: Assessor's primary land-use code from the city's official 'Assessor Land Use' vocabulary (922 codes), e.g. 1110 Single Family Units, 1010 Vacant Residential Lot, 1120 Two Family Unit, 1130 Three Family Unit, 1140 Four Family Unit, 1115 Condominium (>6 units/bldg), 2000 Manufacturing, 3000 Industrial, 4000 Transportation/Communication/Utilities, 5000 Trade, 6000 Services, 7000 Cultural/Entertainment/Recreational, 9000 Undeveloped Land and Water Areas.
parcels.AsrLanduse2: Assessor's secondary land-use code from the same vocabulary as AsrLandUse1; per the portal field definition it is 'present, if necessary, otherwise 0'.
parcels.CDALandUse1: Land-use classification assigned by the CDA (Community Development Administration) planning scheme; no public decode table was found on the portal.
parcels.CDALandUse2: Secondary CDA land-use classification; no public decode table was found on the portal.
parcels.OWNEROCC: Owner-occupancy code giving the dwelling type of an owner-occupied parcel: 1 Single Family, 2 Two-Family, 4 Three-or-Four Family, 5 Five-plus Family, C Condo, X Other (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerOccCode table); null means not flagged owner-occupied.
parcels.VacantLot: 0/1 flag marking the parcel as a vacant lot (counterpart of the Y/N 'Vacant Land' field the portal documents for the historical parcels extract).
parcels.LANDAREA: Assessor-recorded lot area in square feet (values match the parcel polygon's area computed in the foot-based state-plane geometry).
parcels.SQFT: Parcel area in square feet (matches the GIS polygon area; essentially duplicates LANDAREA where both are populated).
parcels.FRONTAGE: Street frontage of the parcel, in feet (assessor lot dimension; portal label 'Frontage').
parcels.AsdLand: Assessed value of the land portion of the parcel in dollars (in Missouri, assessed value is a statutory percentage of appraised value by property class: 19% residential, 32% commercial, 12% agricultural — RSMo 137.115).
parcels.AsdImprove: Assessed value of improvements (buildings) in dollars.
parcels.AsdTotal: Total assessed value (land + improvements) in dollars.
parcels.BillLand: Land assessed value as carried on the tax bill; the Asd*/Bill* distinction (current working assessment vs. billed assessment) is not formally documented on the portal.
parcels.BillImprove: Improvement assessed value as carried on the tax bill (see BillLand note).
parcels.BillTotal: Total assessed value as carried on the tax bill (see BillLand note).
parcels.AprLand: Appraised (market) value of the land in dollars, from which the assessed value is derived.
parcels.CostAprImprove: Cost-approach appraised value of improvements in dollars (name-based; no formal portal definition found).
parcels.TaxBalance: Outstanding (unpaid) property-tax balance for the parcel in dollars (name-based; no formal portal definition found).
parcels.IsAbatedProperty: 0/1 flag indicating the parcel currently has a tax abatement (see AbatementStartYear/AbatementEndYear).
parcels.AbatementStartYear: First tax year of the parcel's tax-abatement period.
parcels.AbatementEndYear: Last tax year of the parcel's tax-abatement period.
parcels.RedevPhase: Redevelopment-abatement phase the parcel is in (city abatement programs are Chapter 99, Chapter 100, Chapter 353 and Enterprise Zone per the 'Abatement Type' vocabulary); phase decode not published.
parcels.RedevYearEnd: Year the parcel's current redevelopment phase ends.
parcels.SpecParcelType: Special-parcel type: C Condo Master (Res/Mixed), K Condo Master (Non-Res), H Highway ROW, R Other ROW, S Special Account, W Water, X Non-parcel Area (city PrclCode.mdb CdSpecParcelType table).
parcels.SubParcelType: Sub-parcel type: A Account Separation, B Back Taxes Owed, C Condo, G Garage/Parking Condo, K Commercial Condo, I Industrial Condo, M Multi-Owner (e.g. leasehold), X Other (incl. signs, air/ground rights), plus bookkeeping codes D/E/P/Q/R/Y (city PrclCode.mdb CdSubParcelType / controlled vocabulary 'Parcel Sub Type').
parcels.Condominium: Condominium flag on the parcel record (legacy documentation shows it as a 0-or-8 component folded into HANDLE; inferred).
parcels.NbrOfUnits: Number of dwelling/occupancy units on the parcel.
parcels.NbrOfApts: Number of apartment units on the parcel (name-based).
parcels.FirstYearBuilt: Year the oldest building on the parcel was built.
parcels.LastYearBuilt: Year the newest building on the parcel was built.
parcels.VacBldgYear: Year the property entered the vacant-building registry (counterpart of VACBLDGYR in the historical extract; name-based).
parcels.ResSalePrice: Most recent residential sale price for the parcel in dollars (name-based).
parcels.ResSaleDate: Date of the most recent residential sale (name-based).
parcels.AddrType: Address-record type: 1 Assessor Legal Address, 2 Assessor Low/High Address, 3 Assessor Legal and Low/High Address, A Corrected/Added, L LRMS Address, P Permit non-Assessor Address, X Non-Assessor Parcel, plus dummy/retired codes Z/V/G/D/Q (city controlled vocabulary 'Address Type').
parcels.LowAddrNum: Lowest house number that can be used to reference this parcel on its primary street (portal field definition).
parcels.HighAddrNum: Highest house number that can be used to reference this parcel on its primary street (portal field definition).
parcels.PARITY: Odd/even parity of the parcel's address numbers, i.e. which side of the street the parcel is on (name-based).
parcels.NLC: The city's internal numeric street code ('NLC') identifying the parcel's primary street in St. Louis address databases; street-name decode not published (type codes exist in the city's corcode.mdb CdNLCType table).
parcels.PrimAddrRecNum: Record number of the parcel's primary address among its address records (name-based).
parcels.SITEADDR: Main address used for the parcel within city records (portal field definition).
parcels.ASRNBRHD: Assessor's neighborhood number (assessment neighborhood, distinct from the citizen neighborhood in NBRHD).
parcels.WARD: Current aldermanic ward number; Ward20/Ward10/Ward00/Ward90 columns carry the 2020/2010/2000/1990 ward definitions respectively.
parcels.OWNERNAME: Owner name of record; OWNERADDR/OWNERCITY/OWNERSTATE/OWNERZIP are the owner's registered mailing address (portal field definitions for the historical extract).
parcels.Zoning: Zoning district code for the parcel (city controlled vocabulary 'Zoning Code'; see the zoning collection's LAYER letters for district names).
parcels.OnFloodBlock: Flag that the parcel's city block touches a floodplain (name-based; see the FloodPlain codes in property-taxes).
parcels.TIFDist: Tax Increment Financing district number the parcel falls in (city controlled vocabulary 'TIF District').
parcels.SpecBusDist: Special Business District / CID number the parcel falls in (city controlled vocabulary 'Special Business District CID').
parcels.LegalDesc1: First line of the parcel's legal description (LegalDesc2-5 continue it).

property-taxes.CityBlock: City block number, first component of the parcel key (portal: 'key fields: CITYBLOCK, PARCEL, OWNERCODE').
property-taxes.Parcel: Parcel number within the city block, second component of the parcel key.
property-taxes.OwnerCode: Taxing-status component of the parcel key: 0 Standard, 1 Redev Taxable, 2 Redev Exempt, 3 In Lieu of Payment, 4 Charity Exempt, 5 Charity Taxable, 6 Mixed Res, 7 Mixed Comm, 8 Sign, 9 Demo/Maintenance Charge (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerCode).
property-taxes.AsrParcelId: The Assessor's parcel ID in the numbering schema introduced in 2021 (portal field definition for ParcelId).
property-taxes.ParcelId: Unformatted parcel ID in the Assessor's 2021 numbering schema (portal field definition).
property-taxes.ColParcelId: Unformatted Collector of Revenue parcel ID — the pre-2021 numbering scheme used across many city departments (portal field definition).
property-taxes.Parcel9: Nine-digit parcel root built from CityBlock and Parcel (schema BBBBbbPPP), described in legacy city documentation as the 'root of all taxable info'.
property-taxes.Handle: Citywide parcel join key (see parcels.HANDLE); the portal marks the numbering schema DEPRECATED.
property-taxes.AsrClassCode: Assessor's owner-class code (100 Individual, 200 Company, 49 Land Re-Utilization, etc.; city controlled vocabulary 'Assessor Class Code').
property-taxes.PropertyClassCode: Statutory property classification: 10 Agricultural, 12 Commercial, 15 Residential, 17 Exempt, plus mixed-class combination codes (city controlled vocabulary 'Property Class Code').
property-taxes.AsrLandUse1: Assessor's primary land-use code (city controlled vocabulary 'Assessor Land Use'; e.g. 1110 Single Family Units, 1010 Vacant Residential Lot, 5000 Trade — see parcels.AsrLandUse1 for more codes).
property-taxes.AsrLanduse2: Secondary land-use code, 'present, if necessary, otherwise 0' (portal field definition).
property-taxes.IsAbatedProperty: 0/1 flag that the parcel has a tax abatement.
property-taxes.AbatementType: Program under which the abatement was granted: CH99 Chapter 99, CH100 Chapter 100, CH353 Chapter 353, EEZ Enterprise Zone (city controlled vocabulary 'Abatement Type').
property-taxes.AbatementStartYear: First tax year of the abatement period.
property-taxes.AbatementEndYear: Last tax year of the abatement period.
property-taxes.AsdLand: Assessed value of land in dollars (Missouri assessed value = 19% residential / 32% commercial / 12% agricultural of appraised value, RSMo 137.115).
property-taxes.AsdImprove: Assessed value of improvements in dollars.
property-taxes.AsdResLand: Assessed land value attributed to the residential class portion (AsdResImprove, AsdComLand, AsdComImprove, AsdAgrLand, AsdAgrImprove are the parallel class-portion splits).
property-taxes.BillYear: Tax year of the bill the Bill* fields refer to.
property-taxes.BillLand: Land assessed value as billed for BillYear; the Asd* vs Bill* distinction (current assessment vs billed assessment) is not formally documented on the portal.
property-taxes.BillImprove: Improvement assessed value as billed for BillYear.
property-taxes.BillTotal: Total assessed value as billed for BillYear.
property-taxes.BillTaxAmt: Total tax amount billed for BillYear in dollars (name-based).
property-taxes.TaxBalDue: Outstanding tax balance due in dollars (name-based).
property-taxes.AprLand: Appraised (market) value of land in dollars; AprResLand/AprResImprove/AprComLand/AprComImprove/AprAgrLand/AprAgrImprove split it by property class, and AprExemptLand/AprExemptImprove carry exempt portions.
property-taxes.OwnerOcc: Owner-occupancy dwelling-type code: 1 Single Family, 2 Two-Family, 4 Three-or-Four Family, 5 Five-plus Family, C Condo, X Other (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerOccCode).
property-taxes.SpecParcelType: Special-parcel type: C/K Condo Master, H Highway ROW, R Other ROW, S Special Account, W Water, X Non-parcel Area (city PrclCode.mdb CdSpecParcelType).
property-taxes.SubParcelType: Sub-parcel type code (A Account Separation, B Back Taxes Owed, C Condo, G Garage/Parking Condo, K Commercial Condo, M Multi-Owner, X Other, plus retirement codes; city 'Parcel Sub Type' vocabulary).
property-taxes.NbrOfSubAccts: Number of sub-accounts under this parcel (e.g. condo units billed separately; name-based).
property-taxes.NbrOfCondos: Number of condominium units associated with the parcel (name-based).
property-taxes.NbrOfUnitsSource: Source system for the NbrOfUnits value: 1 DevNet Building Apartment Data, 2/3 DevNet Land Use with/without Building Rec, 10 Permits, 50 Pre-DevNet Parcel Unit Data, 110/120 overrides, 20 Other (city controlled vocabulary 'Number Of Units Source').
property-taxes.FloodPlain: Floodplain status of the parcel: 10/11 100-Year Flood all/part in, 50/51 500-Year Flood all/part in, 30/31 Levee all/part in (city controlled vocabulary 'Flood Plain Type').
property-taxes.IsHUDQualifiedTract: Flag that the parcel lies in a HUD Qualified Census Tract (name-based).
property-taxes.AsmtAppealType: Type of assessment appeal filed (city controlled vocabulary 'Assessment Appeal Type').
property-taxes.PriorAsdLand: Assessed land value from the prior assessment (PriorAsdImprove/PriorAsdTotal/PriorAsdDate/PriorTaxAmt are the matching prior-cycle values).
property-taxes.RecDailyDate: Recorder of Deeds daily-record date for the latest recorded instrument; RecDailyNum, RecBookNum and RecPageNum are the daily number and book/page references.
property-taxes.GisPrimary: Flag marking the record that represents the parcel in GIS when multiple accounts share a parcel (name-based); GisCityBLock/GisParcel/GisOwnerCode are the GIS-side key components.
property-taxes.AcctPrimary: Flag marking the primary account record for the parcel (name-based).
property-taxes.LRMSParcel: Flag/identifier linking the parcel to the city's LRMS land-records system (the LRMS acronym appears throughout city address vocabularies without an expansion; not formally documented).
property-taxes.LowAddrNum: Lowest house number referencing this parcel on its primary street (portal field definition); HighAddrNum is the highest.
property-taxes.NLC: City internal numeric street code for the parcel's primary street (see parcels.NLC).
property-taxes.FirstDate: Date the record first appeared in the extract (name-based; not formally documented).
property-taxes.LastDate: Date the record was last updated in the extract (name-based; not formally documented).
property-taxes.OwnerUpdate: Date of the last ownership update on the record (name-based; not formally documented).

parcels-history.HANDLE: Zero-padded handle identifier for parcels (official portal field definition for this dataset) — the join key across city parcel data.
parcels-history.era: Snapshot vintage added by this mirror: which yearly source extract (1997-2015 single years, plus a combined 2016-2020 file) the row came from.
parcels-history.UPDATED: Date the source snapshot record was updated (portal label 'UPDATED').
parcels-history.SITEADDR: Site address of the parcel (portal label).
parcels-history.OWNERNAME: Owner name of record (OWNERNAME2 is the overflow line).
parcels-history.OWNERADDR: Owner's house number and street name mailing address (portal field definition); OWNERCITY/OWNERSTATE/OWNERZIP/OWNERCNTRY are the rest of the registered mailing address.
parcels-history.ASMTLAND: Assessment (assessed value) of land in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Land').
parcels-history.ASMTIMPROV: Assessment of improvements in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Improvements').
parcels-history.ASMTTOTAL: Total assessed value in dollars (portal label 'Assessment Total').
parcels-history.ASRCLASS1: Assessor class code — owner-type classification, decoded by the city's 'Assessor Class Code' vocabulary (ASRCLASS2-4 are additional codes).
parcels-history.LANDUSE1: Land-use code decoded by the city's official 'Assessor Land Use' vocabulary, e.g. 1110 Single Family Units, 1010 Vacant Residential Lot (LANDUSE2-4 are additional codes; the portal maps these columns to that vocabulary).
parcels-history.ASRUSE1: Assessor use code (portal label 'Assessor Use Code'); the portal publishes no decode vocabulary for this column (ASRUSE2-4 likewise).
parcels-history.ZONING1: Zoning district code decoded by the city's 'Zoning Code' vocabulary (ZONING2-3 are additional districts where the parcel spans zones).
parcels-history.NUMBLDGS: Number of buildings on the parcel (portal label).
parcels-history.NUMUNITS: Number of units on the parcel (portal label).
parcels-history.LANDAREA: Lot area in square feet (portal label 'Land Area'; units per the current parcels extract where values match polygon areas in feet).
parcels-history.DAILYDATE: Recorder of Deeds daily-record date of the latest recorded instrument (portal label 'Daily Date'); DAILYNUM, BOOKNUM and BOOKPAGE are the daily number and deed book/page references.
parcels-history.BDG1YEAR: Year built of building 1 (portal label 'Building 1 Year'); BDG1AREA is its area and BDG1EXWALL its exterior-wall code.
parcels-history.OWNEROCC: Owner-occupancy dwelling-type code: 1 Single Family, 2 Two-Family, 4 Three-or-Four Family, 5 Five-plus Family, C Condo, X Other (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerOccCode).
parcels-history.VACBLDGYR: Year the property entered the vacant building registry (name-based).
parcels-history.CITYBLOCK: City block number of the parcel key; PARCEL is the parcel number within the block.
parcels-history.PARCEL10: Ten-digit parcel identifier (CityBlock+Parcel+OwnerCode form; see the legacy BBBBbbPPPO schema); PARCEL9 is the nine-digit CityBlock+Parcel root.
parcels-history.LEGAL1: First line of the legal description (LEGAL2-5 continue it; portal labels 'Legal Description').
parcels-history.OWNERGROUP: Owner grouping assigned in the source extract (portal label only; no decode published).

lead-service-lines.address: Street address of the water service connection (layer field alias 'Address').
lead-service-lines.utilmaterial: Pipe material of the utility-owned (public right-of-way) side of the service line, coded: 0 Unknown, 81 Asbestos Cement, 83 Cast Iron, 84 Copper, 88 Ductile Iron, 89 Galvanized Pipe, 93 Polyethylene, 94 PVC, 109 Lead, 110 Brass (ArcGIS coded-value domain; alias 'Right of Way Material').
lead-service-lines.utilsource: How the right-of-way side's material was determined: 1 Existing Records, 2 Test Results, 3 Visual Confirmation, 5 Assumed (ArcGIS coded-value domain 'Utility_Source') — the material-determination basis EPA's Lead and Copper Rule Revisions service-line inventories require.
lead-service-lines.utilstatus: Lead classification of the right-of-way side: 0 Unknown, 1 Lead, 2 Non-Lead, 3 Galvanized Requiring Replacement (ArcGIS domain; these are the four service-line categories of the EPA LCRR service line inventory).
lead-service-lines.custmaterial: Pipe material of the customer-owned (building) side of the service line, same material codes as utilmaterial (ArcGIS domain 'Water_Service_Material'; alias 'Building Side Material').
lead-service-lines.custsource: How the building side's material was determined: 1 Existing Records, 2 Test Results, 3 Visual Confirmation, 4 Notified by Customer, 5 Assumed (ArcGIS domain 'Customer_Source').
lead-service-lines.custstatus: Lead classification of the building side: 0 Unknown, 1 Lead, 2 Non-Lead, 3 Galvanized Requiring Replacement (ArcGIS domain 'Status'; EPA LCRR inventory categories).
lead-service-lines.GlobalID: ArcGIS global unique identifier for the feature.

crime.IncidentDate: Date the incident was reported/recorded by SLMPD.
crime.OccurredFromTime: Date/time the offense began (NIBRS incidents record an occurred-from time).
crime.IncidentNum: SLMPD incident (complaint) number; multiple offense rows can share one incident.
crime.Offense: SLMPD's Missouri statutory offense description for the charge (e.g. 'MURDER 1ST DEGREE', 'STEALING - MOTOR VEHICLE').
crime.NIBRS: FBI NIBRS offense code for the offense, e.g. 09A Murder/Nonnegligent Manslaughter, 13A Aggravated Assault, 23G Theft of Motor Vehicle Parts, 240 Motor Vehicle Theft, 290 Destruction/Damage/Vandalism (FBI NIBRS offense code list).
crime.NIBRSCategory: FBI NIBRS offense category name corresponding to the NIBRS code (e.g. 'Motor Vehicle Theft', 'Aggravated Assault').
crime.SRS_UCR: Legacy FBI Summary Reporting System (SRS/UCR) Part I offense class for the offense: 01 Criminal Homicide, 02 Rape, 03 Robbery, 04 Aggravated Assault, 05 Burglary, 06 Larceny-Theft, 07 Motor Vehicle Theft, 08 Arson (null for non-Part-I offenses).
crime.CrimeAgainst: NIBRS 'Crimes Against' classification of the offense: Person, Property, or Society (FBI NIBRS groups every offense this way); 'Unspecified' appears for some records.
crime.FelMisdCit: Charge-severity flag: F felony, M misdemeanor, with C and I also present (per the column name 'Fel/Misd/Cit' C is presumably citation and I infraction; SLMPD publishes no decode).
crime.IncidentTopSRS_UCR: SRS/UCR class of the most serious offense in the incident (the SRS hierarchy rule reports only the highest offense; inferred from the field name and the SRS hierarchy convention).
crime.IncidentLocation: Street address or block-level location of the incident.
crime.IntersectionOtherLoc: Intersection or other non-address location description for the incident.
crime.District: SLMPD police district number where the incident occurred.
crime.Neighborhood: City neighborhood name of the incident location; NbhdNum is the corresponding neighborhood number (1-79 per the city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).
crime.IncidentSupplemented: Yes/No — whether the incident record has been supplemented (updated) since the original report.
crime.LastSuppDate: Date of the most recent supplement to the incident record.
crime.VictimNum: Victim record identifier assigned by SLMPD (an ID shared by rows describing the same victim, not a count of victims — verified against the data).
crime.FirearmUsed: Whether a firearm was used in the offense.
crime.IncidentNature: Nature-of-incident text as recorded by SLMPD.
crime.keep: Flag added by this mirror's pipeline: true when the record had valid coordinates falling inside the city boundary (geometry is null when false).

electrical-permits.APPTYPE: Permit application type code; always 'AE' (Electrical) in this dataset — codes come from the city 'Permit Application Type' vocabulary (AB Building, AD Demolition, AE Electrical, AM Mechanical, AO Occupancy, AP Plumbing, etc.).
electrical-permits.APPDATE: Date the permit application was filed.
electrical-permits.COMPLETEDATE: Date the permitted work was completed/finaled.
electrical-permits.CANCELDATE: Date the application was cancelled, if it was.
electrical-permits.CANCELTYPE: Cancellation code; only the value 'C' (cancelled) appears in the data and the city publishes no decode for it.
electrical-permits.APPDESCRIPTION: Free-text description of the permitted work.
electrical-permits.ESTPROJECTCOST: Estimated project cost in dollars as declared on the application.
electrical-permits.PROJECTTYPE: Project type code: 1 New Construction, 2 Addition, 3 Alteration, 4 Repair, 5 Replacement, 6 Demolition, 7 Occupancy, 8 Blasting, 9 Other (city 'Permit Project Type' vocabulary).
electrical-permits.MAINSTRUCTYPE: Main structure type code, e.g. 1 One-or-Two Family, 2 Multi Family, 3 Hotel, 19 Industrial, 20 Commercial, 23 Garage (city 'Permit Structure Type' vocabulary); STRUCTYPE1-3 carry additional structure types.
electrical-permits.NBROFUNITS: Number of dwelling/occupancy units covered by the permit.
electrical-permits.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle the permit is attached to (join key to the parcels collections).
electrical-permits.CITYBLOCK: City block number of the permitted parcel; PARCEL is the parcel number within the block, PARCEL9 the nine-digit CityBlock+Parcel root.
electrical-permits.OWNERNAME: Property owner of record at permit time (OWNERADDR/OWNERCITY/OWNERSTATE/OWNERZIP are the owner's mailing address).
electrical-permits.OWNERCODE: Taxing-status component of the parcel key (see parcels.OwnerCode decode).
electrical-permits.PRCLERR: Parcel geocoding match/error code from the city's address-matching system (decode table CdPrclErr in the city's ComCode.mdb, e.g. 1-5 matches to non-LRMS addresses, 9 Outside City).
electrical-permits.NBRHD: City neighborhood number (city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary); ASRNBRHD is the assessor's neighborhood.
electrical-permits.FIRSTDATE: Date the record first appeared in the extract; LASTDATE is its last update (name-based).
electrical-permits.UPDATEGEO: Date/flag of the last geocoding update for the record (name-based).

mechanical-permits.APPTYPE: Permit application type code; 'AM' (Mechanical) in this dataset (city 'Permit Application Type' vocabulary).
mechanical-permits.APPDATE: Date the permit application was filed; ISSUEDATE/COMPLETEDATE/CANCELDATE are the issue, completion and cancellation dates.
mechanical-permits.CANCELTYPE: Cancellation code; only 'C' appears and no decode is published.
mechanical-permits.APPDESCRIPTION: Free-text description of the permitted work.
mechanical-permits.PROJECTTYPE: Project type: 1 New Construction, 2 Addition, 3 Alteration, 4 Repair, 5 Replacement, 6 Demolition, 9 Other (city 'Permit Project Type' vocabulary).
mechanical-permits.MAINSTRUCTYPE: Main structure type code (city 'Permit Structure Type' vocabulary; STRUCTYPE1-3 are additional).
mechanical-permits.NBROFUNITS: Number of units covered by the permit.
mechanical-permits.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle (join key to parcels).
mechanical-permits.CAREOFNAME: 'Care of' contact name on the application (CAREOFADDR/CAREOFCITY/CAREOFSTATE/CAREOFZIP are that contact's address).
mechanical-permits.PRCLERR: Parcel geocoding match/error code (city ComCode.mdb CdPrclErr).
mechanical-permits.OWNERCODE: Taxing-status component of the parcel key (see parcels.OwnerCode).

plumbing-permits.APPTYPE: Permit application type code; 'AP' (Plumbing) in this dataset (city 'Permit Application Type' vocabulary).
plumbing-permits.APPDATE: Date the permit application was filed; ISSUEDATE/COMPLETEDATE/CANCELDATE are the issue, completion and cancellation dates.
plumbing-permits.CANCELTYPE: Cancellation code; only 'C' appears and no decode is published.
plumbing-permits.APPDESCRIPTION: Free-text description of the permitted work.
plumbing-permits.PROJECTTYPE: Project type: 1 New Construction, 2 Addition, 3 Alteration, 4 Repair, 5 Replacement, 6 Demolition, 9 Other (city 'Permit Project Type' vocabulary).
plumbing-permits.MAINSTRUCTYPE: Main structure type code (city 'Permit Structure Type' vocabulary; STRUCTYPE1-3 are additional).
plumbing-permits.NBROFUNITS: Number of units covered by the permit.
plumbing-permits.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle (join key to parcels).
plumbing-permits.PRCLERR: Parcel geocoding match/error code (city ComCode.mdb CdPrclErr).
plumbing-permits.OWNERCODE: Taxing-status component of the parcel key (see parcels.OwnerCode).

occupancy-permits.APPTYPE: Permit application type code; 'AO' Occupancy (or 'AX' Occupancy-Old) per the city 'Permit Application Type' vocabulary.
occupancy-permits.APPDATE: Date the occupancy-permit application was filed; ISSUEDATE/COMPLETEDATE/CANCELDATE are the issue, completion and cancellation dates.
occupancy-permits.CANCELTYPE: Cancellation code; only 'C' appears and no decode is published.
occupancy-permits.OCCNAME: Name of the occupant/business applying for occupancy (name-based).
occupancy-permits.NEWUSE: Text description of the new (proposed) use of the structure.
occupancy-permits.OLDUSE: Text description of the previous use of the structure.
occupancy-permits.NEWUSEGROUP1: Building-code use group of the new use, e.g. A Assembly, B Business, E Educational, F Factory, H Hazardous, I Institutional, M Mercantile, R Residential, S Storage, U Utility with numeric subgroups like R-2, F-1 (city 'Permit Use Group' vocabulary); NEWUSEGROUP2-3 are additional groups.
occupancy-permits.OLDUSEGROUP1: Building-code use group of the previous use (same vocabulary; OLDUSEGROUP2-3 additional).
occupancy-permits.PROJECTTYPE: Project type code; occupancy permits are type 7 'Occupancy' (city 'Permit Project Type' vocabulary).
occupancy-permits.MAINSTRUCTYPE: Main structure type code (city 'Permit Structure Type' vocabulary).
occupancy-permits.NBROFUNITS: Number of units covered by the permit.
occupancy-permits.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle (join key to parcels).
occupancy-permits.PRCLERR: Parcel geocoding match/error code (city ComCode.mdb CdPrclErr).
occupancy-permits.OWNERCODE: Taxing-status component of the parcel key (see parcels.OwnerCode).

vacancy-composite.TOLEMI_ID: Property identifier assigned by Tolemi (the BuildingBlocks data platform SLDC uses to assemble its vacancy composite; the source layer is SLDC.SLDC.Tol_Def_Vac_NP).
vacancy-composite.PID1: First parcel identifier for the property as carried in the Tolemi composite (exact scheme not documented; PID2 is a second identifier).
vacancy-composite.STREET_ADD: Street address of the property (shapefile-truncated name).
vacancy-composite.TOLEMI_DEF: Tolemi 'definite vacancy' determination for the property — the flag/category under which the parcel qualified for this definite-vacant composite (layer name Tol_Def_Vac; no public decode found).
vacancy-composite.LRA_OWNED_: Whether the property is owned by the Land Reutilization Authority (shapefile-truncated flag).
vacancy-composite.LRA_RORE: LRA inventory attribute (untruncated meaning not documented; no public decode found).
vacancy-composite.VACANT_BUI: Vacant-building indicator (shapefile-truncated 'VACANT_BUILDING', i.e. on the city vacant building registry).
vacancy-composite.NSR_OWNED_: Flag for ownership recorded in the city's vacancy pipeline under 'NSR' (not expanded in any public documentation found).
vacancy-composite.LAND_SIZE: Land area of the parcel (units not documented in the source; city parcel land areas are square feet).
vacancy-composite.OWNER_NAME: Owner name of record; OWNER_ADDR is the owner's mailing address.
vacancy-composite.TAX_DELINQ: Tax delinquency indicator for the property.
vacancy-composite.BISA_SCORE: Building Inspection/condition score carried in the composite ('BISA' not expanded in public documentation).
vacancy-composite.LRA_STATUS: Status of the property within the LRA inventory; LRA_DATE is the associated date.
vacancy-composite.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle (join key to parcels); COLPARCELI is the truncated Collector parcel ID.

market-value-analysis.geoid: Census 2020 block group code (AGOL layer documentation).
market-value-analysis.MVACluster: Market cluster letter assigned to the block group by Reinvestment Fund's 2024 Market Value Analysis of St. Louis — clusters group block groups with similar housing-market conditions.
market-value-analysis.MSP2123_CA: Median sales price of residential home sales 2021-2023, excluding sales under $1,000, condo-adjusted (AGOL layer documentation).
market-value-analysis.MSPVar2123: Variation of home values 2021-2023 (standard deviation divided by average value).
market-value-analysis.PHHOO: Households that reported owning their home as a share of all households, ACS 2018-2022.
market-value-analysis.CHHOO: Count of households that reported owning their homes, ACS 2018-2022 (documented as 'CHOO' in the layer description).
market-value-analysis.CHH: Count of all households, ACS 2018-2022 (documented as 'CHIH' in the layer description).
market-value-analysis.PPerm10k: Share of residential parcels with renovation/addition permits June 2022-June 2024 whose total permit value exceeded $10,000 (excluding demolitions).
market-value-analysis.CPerm10k: Count of residential parcels with such >$10,000 renovation/addition permits, June 2022-June 2024.
market-value-analysis.CResPcl: Count of residential parcels in the block group (denominator for the parcel-share indicators; AGOL description text is garbled for this field).
market-value-analysis.PDSale2123: Distressed residential sales (foreclosures, sheriff sales, tax sales, bank-sold) as a share of residential transactions 2021-2023.
market-value-analysis.CDSale2123: Count of distressed residential home sales 2021-2023.
market-value-analysis.PVacBuild: Vacant housing units as a share of all housing units, 2024.
market-value-analysis.PVResLand: Vacant residential land as a share of all residential land, 2024.
market-value-analysis.VacLotAcre: Vacant residential land area in acres.
market-value-analysis.PResArea: Residential land area as a share of all land area, 2024.
market-value-analysis.Subsidy: Share of households with a housing subsidy (LIHTC, Public Housing, Housing Choice Voucher, Multifamily), from the National Housing Preservation Database/HUD-POSH/St. Louis Housing Authority.
market-value-analysis.CSubHH: Count of households with a housing subsidy (same sources as Subsidy).

land-use.SLUP_LATES: Strategic Land Use Plan category code (latest designation): NPA Neighborhood Preservation Area, NDA Neighborhood Development Area, NCA Neighborhood Commercial Area, RCA Regional Commercial Area, BIPA Business/Industrial Preservation Area, BIDA Business/Industrial Development Area, IPDA Institutional Preservation and Development Area, ROSPDA Recreational/Open Space Preservation and Development Area, SMUA Specialty Mixed Use Area, OA Opportunity Area (category names from the city's adopted 2005 Strategic Land Use Plan document).
land-use.Status: Status of the plan geography (all rows are 'Active' via the Boundary field in the current extract).
land-use.NAME: Name of the SLUP amendment area the polygon belongs to, where applicable (e.g. '26 Midtown Corridor'); blank for unamended base-plan areas.
land-use.PDA_RESOLU: Planning agency resolution reference for the amendment that set this designation (PDA_RESOL_ is the truncated companion field; inferred from name).
land-use.UPDATED: Date the record was last updated.
land-use.COMMENTS: Planner's free-text comments on the amendment/designation.
land-use.PLANNER: Planning staff member associated with the amendment record.
land-use.GEOGRAPHY: List of city block numbers / census identifiers the amendment covers (observed values are space-separated block numbers).
land-use.Boundary: Whether the geography is the active plan boundary ('Active' in current data).

zoning.LAYER: Zoning district letter, per the city's ArcGIS renderer: A Single-Family Residential Dwelling District, B Two-Family Dwelling District, C/D/E Multiple-Family Dwelling Districts, F Neighborhood Commercial District, G Local Commercial and Office District, H Area Commercial District, I Central Business District, J Industrial District, K Unrestricted District, L Jefferson Memorial District.
zoning.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle of the parcel the zoning polygon corresponds to (join key to the parcels collections).

csb-311-requests.REQUESTID: System-generated unique record number for the service request (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PROBLEMCODE: Type of report — the CSB problem code (portal field definition); PLAIN_ENGLISH_NAME_FOR_PROBLEMCODE is its public title.
csb-311-requests.DESCRIPTION: Same as the problem code or a more specific explanation of it (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.EXPLANATION: Additional details about the problem code, including the conditions under which it should be used (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.GROUP: Category the Citizens' Service Bureau currently groups that request type within (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.STATUS: Status of the request (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.CALLERTYPE: Method used by the customer to report the issue — Phone, Web, Twitter, CSB LTR, CSB VCML, etc. (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.DATETIMEINIT: Date/time the request was initiated, auto-stamped when saved or submitted online (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.DATETIMECLOSED: Date/time the request was closed, auto-stamped when an employee closed it (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.DATECANCELLED: Date cancelled — indicates the request was a duplicate, cancelled by the caller, or entered in error (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.DATEINVTDONE: Date the investigation/inspection was done, which may differ from when a clerk closed the request (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PRJCOMPLETEDATE: Projected completion date — the date by which the responsible division (SUBMITTO) should have the initial inspection completed (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.SUBMITTO: City division or department responsible for handling the request (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PROBADDRESS: Address or intersection where the problem is occurring (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PROBADDTYPE: Problem address type: A = Parcel, B = Intersection (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PROBZIP: ZIP code of the problem location, often blank (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.NEIGHBORHOOD: City neighborhood number 1-79 of the problem location (portal field definition, city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).
csb-311-requests.WARD: Ward number of the problem location (portal field definition).
csb-311-requests.PARENT_ID: Identifier of the parent problem-code node in the CSB problem-code hierarchy (GRANDPARENT_ID/PARENT_NODE/GRANDPARENT_NODE are the higher levels; inferred from names — not in the portal field list).
csb-311-requests.PUBLICRESOLUTION: Public-facing resolution text recorded when the request was resolved (name-based; not in the portal field list).
csb-311-requests.PROBLEMSID: Internal identifier of the problem record (name-based; not in the portal field list).
csb-311-requests.keep: Flag added by this mirror's pipeline: true when the record had valid coordinates inside the city boundary (geometry is null when false).

election-results-nov-2024.F_Precinct: Precinct label as reported in the November 2024 canvass file.
election-results-nov-2024.Precinct_Reporting: Whether/what share of the precinct had reported.
election-results-nov-2024.Ballots_Cast: Ballots cast in the precinct; Turnout_Percentage is Ballots_Cast over Registered_Voters.
election-results-nov-2024.Contest_Title: Name of the contest (office or question); Contest_ID and Contest_Party identify it and its party where applicable.
election-results-nov-2024.Choice_Name: Candidate or ballot-choice name; Choice_ID and Choice_Party identify it.
election-results-nov-2024.Total_Votes: Total votes for the choice in the precinct across all voting modes.
election-results-nov-2024.Total_Overvotes: Overvotes — ballots where more choices were marked than allowed, so no vote counted (standard U.S. election tabulation term).
election-results-nov-2024.Total_Undervotes: Undervotes — ballots where fewer choices were marked than allowed (including blank), so a potential vote was not cast.
election-results-nov-2024.Absentee_Voting_Votes: Votes for the choice cast by mail absentee; the parallel *_Overvotes/*_Undervotes/*_Invalid_Votes columns break those measures out per voting mode.
election-results-nov-2024.Election_Day_Voting_Votes: Votes for the choice cast at the polls on election day.
election-results-nov-2024.Provisional_Voting_Votes: Votes for the choice cast on provisional ballots.
election-results-nov-2024.Absentee_Voting___In_Person_Vot: Votes cast by in-person (no-excuse) absentee voting (column name truncated by the source; the __Ove/__Und/__Inv companions are its overvote/undervote/invalid counts).

election-precincts.name: Precinct name/identifier for the election precinct polygon.

polling-places.pollingPlace: Name of the polling place; pollingPlaceAddress and pollingPlaceZipCode locate it and pollingPlaceID identifies it.
polling-places.ParcelId: Parcel ID of the polling location (joinable to the parcels collections); handle is the parcel handle.
polling-places.Early_Voting_Available: Whether early voting is available at the site; noExcuseVoting and cityWideVoting flag no-excuse absentee and any-voter citywide voting sites.
polling-places.disabledentry: Accessible-entry flag for the site; entrydetails carries entry directions.

animal-bites.REQUESTID: Request ID number of the submitted animal-bite ticket (portal field definition).
animal-bites.PROBLEMCODE: Always 'Animal Bite' in this dataset (portal field definition).
animal-bites.DATETIMEINIT: Date/time the ticket was created (portal field definition); DATETIMECLOSED, DATECANCELLED and DATEINVTDONE are the closure, cancellation and investigation dates.
animal-bites.HOUSE_NUMBER: Hundred-block house number where the issue occurred (portal field definition — addresses are generalized to the block).
animal-bites.STREET: Street or streets of the ticket location (portal field definition).
animal-bites.WARD: Ward of the ticket location (portal field definition).
animal-bites.STATUS: Status of the ticket (portal field definition).

siren-locations.Siren: Identifier of the outdoor warning siren (the portal's siren spreadsheet labels this 'Siren Number').
siren-locations.SIREN_LOCATION_ADDRESS: Address/location of the siren (portal label 'Siren Location/Address').
siren-locations.FACILITY: Facility the siren is located at (name-based; this extract is a field-inspection layer richer than the portal spreadsheet).
siren-locations.Date_Last_Tested: Date the siren was last tested; 'Working' records whether it worked (name-based inspection fields).
siren-locations.Solar_Panels_Condition: Condition of the siren's solar panels; Batteries_Condition and SolarandBatteryNotes are the companion battery fields (name-based inspection fields).
siren-locations.PoleHeight: Height of the siren pole; PoleMount, PoleLean, Polemountedin and PoleConditionNotes describe the pole installation and condition (name-based inspection fields).

property-sales.CityBlock: City block component of the sold parcel's key; Parcel and OwnerCode complete the key (see parcels).
property-sales.SaleNum: Sequential sale number for the parcel.
property-sales.SaleType: Coded sale type from the city 'Sale Type' vocabulary, e.g. 11 Investor, 25 House/Vacant Lot, 36/37 Condo with/without parking, 42 Government, 46 Gift, 47-49 Exempt, 70 Foreclosure, 80 Foreclosure Sale, 61 Inter-Corporate; SaleTypeDescr carries the decoded description and SaleTypeOther any free-text type.
property-sales.SaleDate: Date of the sale; LRMSSaleDate is the sale date as carried in the LRMS land-records system.
property-sales.NbrOfParcels: Number of parcels included in the transaction; SalePricePerParcel is SalePrice divided across them.
property-sales.SaleDocNum: Recorder of Deeds document number for the sale.

lra-property.LRA: Flag/identifier that the property is in the Land Reutilization Authority (LRA) inventory — the city land bank's holdings.
lra-property.PropNS_Status: Status of the property in the Proposition NS program (the voter-approved Neighborhood Stabilization bond program that stabilizes LRA-owned vacant buildings).
lra-property.Handle: Citywide parcel handle (join key to the parcels collections); CityBlock/Parcel/ParcelId are the parcel key fields.
lra-property.Status: Inventory status of the LRA property.
lra-property.Usage: Current/intended usage classification of the property in the LRA inventory.
lra-property.LRA_PRICING: LRA pricing category or price for the property.
lra-property.SideLotEligible: Whether the lot qualifies for the LRA side-lot program (sale of vacant lots to adjacent owners).
lra-property.AppraisedVal: Appraised value of the property; AssessorsTotal is the assessor's total assessed value.
lra-property.ACQUISITION_DATE: Date the LRA acquired the property.
lra-property.SALEPRICE: Sale price when the property was sold out of the inventory; CLOSING_COMPLETED marks completed closings.
lra-property.PCA_Date: Date of the property condition assessment (name-based).
lra-property.GreenLienStatus: Status of any 'green lien' (vacant-lot greening assessment) on the property (name-based).

tax-abated-parcels.IsAbatedProperty: Flag that the parcel has an active tax abatement (this collection shares the full assessor parcel schema — see the parcels collection for the other columns).
tax-abated-parcels.AbatementStartYear: First tax year of the abatement period.
tax-abated-parcels.AbatementEndYear: Last tax year of the abatement period.
tax-abated-parcels.AsrLandUse1: Assessor land-use code (city 'Assessor Land Use' vocabulary; see parcels.AsrLandUse1).
tax-abated-parcels.HANDLE: Citywide parcel handle (join key to the parcels collections).

city-blocks.BLOCK_HANDLE: Handle identifier of the city block (block-level analogue of the parcel HANDLE).
city-blocks.GeoCityBlockPart: Sub-part designator when a GIS city block is split into parts.
city-blocks.NBRHD: City neighborhood number (city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary); WARD10/Ward20/Ward00/Ward90 and the PRECINCT*/CensTract*/CensBlock* columns are the block's assignments in each redistricting/census cycle.
city-blocks.POLICEDIST: SLMPD police district containing the block.
city-blocks.HouseConsDist: Housing Conservation District the block falls in (city 'Housing Conservation District' vocabulary).
city-blocks.OnFloodBlock: Flag that the block touches a floodplain.
